d:
A massive, hulking beast resembling a hybrid of a highland cow and a monster with thick, shaggy fur of deep mahogany brown. The head features large, curved horns of slate grey and a wide, bovine snout. The body is heavy and muscular, supported by four thick legs ending in cloven hooves. The tail is short, tufted, and mahogany brown.
BODY COLOR: deep mahogany brown
